does: Answers whether a creature counts as surprised for the surprise system: it carries esv::combat::SurprisedStealthRequestOneFrameComponent this tick, or its status container holds the status SURPRISED on a status entity with esv::status::ActiveComponent.

evidence.says: one lookup of the one-frame component by its type index, then a walk of the status container comparing each status id with the fixed string SURPRISED
a count-only probe during a hidden archer's shot at one of two hostile humans shows 6 calls: 3 and 1 from the gatherer of joining creatures, 2 from the gatherer of a stealth target's allies
